text:
Maya: Heads up — we're seeing a spike in embeddings latency & 429s in eu-west1 after the 1.2.3 roll. Need an expedited hotfix to swap to the quantized variant v1.2.3-q.
TJ: Can we fast-track? Oncall capacity looks available.
Maya: Patch built, image sha=sha-abcdef1. Bench stable, mem down ~20% in lab.
Omar: Requesting signoff to skip the 15m canary hold. Risk = brief 429 bump during cache warm-up.
Priya: +1 from SRE if we do a staggered rollout (start 10% safe-traffic) and pin to dedicated pool.
deploy-bot: @channel deploy request received: service=embedder region=eu-west1 image=sha-abcdef1 rollout=canary(10%)->100% steps=5 --requested-by=Maya
Maya: Draft release note: "Fix: reduce memory peak during KV-cache updates, mitigates transient 429s. No model output changes." https://docs.internal/releases/1.2.3-hotfix
TJ: Docs + support notified? We should paste the release-note into GH and link in customer comms.
Omar: I approve skip-canary hold for 15m given customer impact. ops-oncall please monitor thresholds closely.
ops-oncall: ack. Keeping pager open 30m. Alerts: error-rate and p50/p95 token latency, 429 > baseline+5% will trigger.
Priya: I'll pin to eu-embed-pool to reduce noisy neighbors. Maya, add --node-pool=eu-embed-pool to deploy.
Maya: Done, adding node-pool flag.
deploy-bot: Deploy started at 1759012345. Step 1/5: canary -> 10% traffic.
Maya: Observing logs; KV cache warm-up in progress. No obvious regressions.
deploy-bot: Step 3/5: 50% traffic at 1759012352. No errors reported in SLI window.
ops-oncall: seeing 2% drop in 429s vs baseline, latency improving slightly.
Maya: Rolling to 100% now.
deploy-bot: Rollout complete: image=sha-abcdef1 -> 100% at 1759012358.
TJ: Nice. Please file the quick postmortem and attach any perf snapshots.
Maya: PR for the release note and changelog: https://github.com/redwood-inference/releases/pull/789
Priya: Locking release notes and sending changelog to affected customers.
ops-oncall: Monitoring for 30m, no alerts so far.
Maya: Closing thread — thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
